data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English, Stanleigh is a compound name consisting of 'stan' meaning stone and 'leah' meaning wood or clearing. The name was commonly given to those who lived near a wooded area with a prominent stone feature. The name Stanleigh carries the meaning “Stone from the woodland” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Stanleigh usually hope their child will grow to embody stone from the woodland and live with faith, good character and purpose.
